title: Hippocrates Hot Sauce
excerpt: ½ C. olive oil ¾ T. kelp powder   3 red peppers 1½ T. chili powder   2 Garlic Cloves 1½ T. hot chili powder   2-3 T. lemon or lime juice ½ T.
content:
½ C. olive oil ¾ T. kelp powder
3 red peppers 1½ T. chili powder
2 Garlic Cloves 1½ T. hot chili powder
2-3 T. lemon or lime juice ½ T. psyllium husk powder (to desired thickness)

Yield: 2 cups

  1. Blend all ingredients well.

*Note that the psyllium will take some time to take effect. Wait a few minutes before adding more, if needed.
